The '''IM-S-653 orbital garrison''', also known as '''The Hexostar''' was a relatively new line of Imperial garrisons specializing in planetary orbit-related objectives created by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]], also capable of tracking down and eliminating any surface or space-based target.<ref name="IHB" />

==Characteristics==
A Hexostar were two standard garrisons locked together base-to-base. Despite being advertised as the most cost-efficient solution,<ref name="IHB" /> this variation was rarely deployed. These garrisons were only deployed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbits]] around extremely hostile and dangerous planets. This provided the troops on the ground with an orbital fire base and also made the headquarters extra secure. Orbiting Garrisons could support a full [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] and several orbital [[Spacetug/Legends|tugships]]. Since the garrisons lacked engines, the tugs were the only means of propulsion.<ref name="IG">{{JournalCite|12|Imperial Garrisons}}</ref>

However, orbiting garrisons created a controversy with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]], which considered all space-deployed units their jurisdiction. In the end, the command on orbiting garrisons was split between Navy and Army, with one base commanded by an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]], the other one by a [[Major General]]. Additionally, a new orbital defense platform for the Navy was put into production.<ref name="IG" />

In addition, according to the [[Rogue Leader/Legends|leader]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who had just returned with his group from [[Ootoola]], the hexostar had a blind spot around the equators that acted as a critical weakpoint to the garrison.<ref name="IHB" />
